en: Fixed Fable models listed in `availableModels` not appearing in the `/model` picker for sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway; such a model now shows its built-in row in place of a `modelPicker` row added for the same model
zh: 修复了 `availableModels` 中列出的 Fable 模型在登录 Claude 应用网关的 session 中不显示在 `/model` 选择器中的问题；现在此类模型会显示其内置行，替代为同一模型添加的 `modelPicker` 行
